app.title: Echoes of Azeroth
app.tagline: Your own World of Warcraft server, in a few clicks.
app.closing: Stopping the servers cleanly before closing…
home.status.notInstalledBody: Install {emulator} with its modules. The launcher downloads ready-made servers: nothing is compiled on your computer.
home.keepRunning: Keep the servers running after the game is closed
home.readyBody: Ready. Play starts the servers, then the game once the world is up.
home.needClient: Choose your game folder to play (the servers can already be started).
home.gameRunning: The game is running. The servers stop when you close it.
home.unfinished: A change was interrupted. Resume it before starting the servers: nothing is lost.
home.crashed: A server stopped unexpectedly. Its console shows the last lines; the full logs are in the instance's logs folder.
servers.title: Servers
client.explain: Point to your own {version} client (build {build}), the folder that contains the game executable. It is never downloaded or shared.
client.whichLocale: Several languages are installed. Which one do you play in?
wizard.clientLater: You can also choose it after the installation.
wizard.soloBody: Only this computer can connect. Recommended.
wizard.lanBody: Other computers at home can join (Windows may ask to allow it).
wizard.sizeHint: First installation: about 2 GB to download. It can be resumed if interrupted.
progress.title: Applying changes
progress.rollingBack: Something failed: undoing the changes to leave everything as it was…
progress.cancelHint: Cancelling stops after the current step and puts things back (an installation resumes later).
update.title: Updates
update.body: Installs the server build of the current release. Every database is backed up first.
update.upToDate: This realm already runs the latest build.
repair.body: Repair reinstalls the server files and configuration and checks the databases (backed up first). Characters and accounts are kept.
repair.done: Repaired: server files and configuration reinstalled.
crash.notice: Echoes of Azeroth closed unexpectedly last time. You can send the report to help fix it: nothing is sent unless you submit it.
crash.issueIntro: The launcher closed unexpectedly. What were you doing at that moment?
appUpdate.stopFirst: Stop the servers to install it.
settings.stopFirst: Stop the servers to change modules or options.
settings.rebuild: Removing these modules rebuilds {databases} (a few minutes). Characters and accounts are kept.
settings.optionsHint: Applied to the servers and, when needed, to your game folder at the next launch.
modules.title: Modules
modules.optionalHint: Optional modules can be added or removed at any time.
modules.unavailable: The catalog is only available inside the desktop app.
modules.empty: No game version is available in the catalog.
account.title: Game account
account.body: Create the account you log in with in the game. It stays on your computer.
account.admin: Game master (administrator commands in the game)
account.created: Account {name} created. Log in with it in the game.
terminals.title: Terminals
terminals.notStarted: Start the servers to see their output.
error.catalog.missing: The game catalog is missing from this installation. Reinstall Echoes of Azeroth.
error.catalog.unreadable: The game catalog could not be read. Reinstall Echoes of Azeroth; if it happens again, report the problem.
error.catalog.invalid: The game catalog contains inconsistencies. Update Echoes of Azeroth; if it happens again, report the problem.
error.client.notFound: No game found in this folder. Choose the folder that contains the game executable.
error.client.wrongBuild: This game is build {found}; this realm needs {version} (build {expected}).
error.client.locale: No supported language was found in this game folder.
error.client.ambiguousLocale: Several languages are installed ({found}): choose one.
error.client.notWritable: The launcher cannot write in this game folder. Move the game out of Program Files, then choose it again.
error.client.inUse: A game file is in use. Close the game, then try again.
error.client.busy: The game is already being prepared or played from this launcher.
error.client.conflict: A file in your game folder would be replaced. Move it away, then try again (the details name it).
error.assets.missing: A module file is missing. Apply the module options again (Server settings).
error.operation.rolledBack: The change failed and was undone: everything is as before. Try again; if it fails again, report the problem.
error.operation.cancelled: Cancelled. Run the same action again to resume.
error.operation.failed: A step failed ({step}). Run the same action again to resume.
error.operation.rollbackFailed: The change failed and could not be fully undone. Report the problem with the details below before trying again.
error.operation.busy: Another change is running. Wait for it to finish.
error.index.invalid: The list of server builds could not be verified. Check your connection and try again later.
error.network.download: A download failed. Check your Internet connection, then try again: it resumes where it stopped.
error.instance.busy: This realm is in use (running, or being changed). Wait or stop it first.
error.instance.unfinished: A change of this realm was interrupted. Resume it first (Home tab).
error.instance.damaged: Server files are missing. Run the update to repair them.
error.port.none: No free network port was found. Close other servers, then try again.
error.port.inUse: Port {port} is used by another program (another server?). Close it, then try again.
error.modules.conflict: These modules cannot be used together.
error.server.startFailed: {process}: the start failed. Its console shows why.
error.account.invalidName: The account name must be 1 to 17 letters or digits.
error.account.invalidPassword: The password must be 1 to 16 characters, without spaces.
error.database.failed: The database reported an error. Try again; if it happens again, report the problem.
error.appUpdate.failed: The launcher update could not be installed (download or signature check failed). Try again later.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. If it happens again, report the problem.
footer.disclaimer: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft is a trademark of Blizzard Entertainment. You provide your own game client.
footer.short: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.
backups.title: Backups
backups.body: A backup keeps the player data: characters, accounts and bots. One is also made automatically before each update, repair or restore; only the last 5 of those are kept. Your own backups stay until you delete them.
backups.stopFirst: Stop the servers to make or restore a backup.
backups.restored: The player data is back as it was on {date}.
backups.confirm: Characters, accounts and bots go back to {date}. Everything played since is replaced (the current state is backed up first).
error.backup.notFound: This backup no longer exists. Refresh the list.
error.backup.unusable: This file holds no player data of this realm: it cannot be restored.
error.backup.folder: The backups folder cannot be opened.
bots.title: Bots
bots.body: Settings of the bots that populate the realm. They apply at the next start; stop the servers to change them.
bots.none: This realm has no bot module.
bots.noOptions: The bot module has no setting to change here.
lan.title: Join a game on the local network
lan.body: Play on a realm hosted by another computer of your network: enter the address its launcher shows. No server runs on this computer.
lan.needClient: Choose your game folder first (in the install panel above).
lan.patches: If the host enabled module options that change the game files, copy its patch files into your game too.
lan.launched: The game is launching, pointed at {address}.
error.lan.invalidAddress: Enter the address of the host computer, for example 192.168.1.20.
